entries.note: referenceTotal adds unitPrice quantity times; production multiplies with safe-integer guards
entries.protects: wrong totals and missed overflow for generated carts
entries.doesNotGuarantee: carts beyond the generator distribution; currency rounding (integers only)

entries.note: expected totals are literals from the example table
expected sum uses the same quantity*price arithmetic, widened to u64; independent for overflow semantics, not for the formula itself
entries.doesNotGuarantee: a formula error shared by test and production (covered by the rstest example cases)

entries.note: TestTotalBillingBoundaries literals plus fuzz overflow corpus
entries.protects: quantity/price boundaries, cross-line overflow, save failure

entries.note: OpenAPI 3.1 document is written separately from the handlers
entries.protects: undocumented status codes and response shape drift
entries.doesNotGuarantee: business correctness of values that satisfy the schema

entries.note: expectations come from the consumer's needs, verified against the provider
entries.doesNotGuarantee: fields the consumer does not use

entries.note: each abuse case also runs against an unsafe variant that must fail the same oracle
entries.protects: IDOR, privilege escalation, replay, token forgery, SQL injection

entries.note: searches all emitted telemetry for the exact secret values
entries.doesNotGuarantee: secrets encoded or split across fields

entries.note: provider-side charge ledger is counted, not the client's view
entries.protects: double charge under retries, drops, duplicates
entries.doesNotGuarantee: faults outside the simulation model (TCP resets are covered by chaos.test.mjs)

entries.note: latency measured from intended start; runs with generator lag are inconclusive
entries.protects: SLO regressions, coordinated omission, unbounded queues

entries.note: counts executed side effects in the sandbox; bypass control shows three
entries.protects: out-of-scope tool effects under prompt injection

entries.note: role-based assertions on the visible success status and failure alert
entries.protects: broken purchase journey across three engines
entries.doesNotGuarantee: visual regressions and accessibility beyond role/name
